reference.source: public callable attributes of a SageMath Graph instance
reference.unit: public Graph methods available in the reference installation

metric.meaning: Sage.js implements 77 exact-name methods from SageMath's 411-method public Graph surface. This measures API breadth, not semantic depth or performance.

internalMethodCoverage.meaning: Every public function or alias currently defined by the Sage.js graph module is assigned to an executable semantic test.

facets.name: SageMath public API breadth
facets.detail: 77 of 411 callable methods on a SageMath Graph instance have exact-name Sage.js implementations.

facets.name: Implemented API test assignment
facets.detail: 130 of 130 public graph-module functions and aliases are assigned to executable semantic tests; the test fails when a new method is left unassigned.

facets.name: Core graph semantics
facets.detail: Mutation, arbitrary vertices, labels, loops, multiedges, traversal, distances, connectivity, transformations, matrices, serialization, and directed algorithms have focused checks.

facets.name: Exact combinatorial algorithms
facets.detail: Isomorphism certificates, canonical labeling, automorphism groups, cliques, independent sets, vertex covers, coloring, spanning trees, and bipartite certificates are regression tested.

facets.name: Generators, database, and plotting
facets.detail: Every implemented named generator, lazy database query operation, and graph-specific Plotly route has an executable test.

facets.name: Research-scale performance
facets.detail: The readable exact implementation is not yet backed by bliss, nauty, igraph, or OGDF-class native kernels, and no competitive performance claim is made.

limitations: Method assignment coverage does not imply exhaustive combinations of arguments, error paths, or graph families.
The SageMath denominator includes specialized algorithms from many optional graph packages; matching all 411 methods is a long-term scope target.
Performance and memory coverage need reproducible benchmark suites on dedicated hosts.
